showrunner_note: Round 1's two hard fails were real and the run took three rounds to close them, which is what the round rule is for. The frame 1 defect is the one worth keeping: the figure was at X -13, which at that frame's camera projects to x -644, off the left edge of a 1080 px frame. Nothing caught it. layout_check, qa.py, plan_render_check, craft_floor and a pixel critic all passed the frame, because every one of them measures what IS in the rect and none asks whether a thing the dossier declared is in it at all.
